avoid_supplements.name: Metoclopramide
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dopamine antagonist directly opposes ropinirole's therapeutic mechanism; reduces efficacy in Parkinson's disease management
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use alternative antiemetics (ondansetron, domperidone in select regions)

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer increases ropinirole metabolism, reducing plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or monitor for loss of symptom control; dose adjustment may be needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk and potential additive CNS depression; may impair dopaminergic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider safer alternatives for anxiety management

caution_supplements.name: Iron Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce ropinirole absorption if taken simultaneously; iron binds to dopamine agonists in GI tract
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; take iron at different time of day

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS stimulation effects; theoretical risk of excessive dopaminergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased tremor, agitation, or sleep disturbances; dose adjustment possible

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depressant effects; may increase sedation and dizziness risk
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel patient on fall risk and avoid concurrent sedating activities

avoid_foods.name: High-dose Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine) containing foods/supplements
avoid_foods.mechanism: Pyridoxine antagonizes dopamine effects and may significantly reduce ropinirole efficacy in Parkinson's disease
avoid_foods.action: Avoid B6 supplementation >10mg/day; maintain consistent moderate dietary B6 intake; monitor symptom stability

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay ropinirole absorption and slow onset of action; does not reduce overall bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take ropinirole consistently with or without food; establish routine to maintain stable plasma levels

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages/foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may potentiate CNS stimulation and increase tremor, insomnia, or tachycardia risk
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake (limit to <200mg/day); monitor for increased adverse effects

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increases orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, and sedation risk
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; counsel on fall risk and impaired cognition; avoid concurrent use with high doses

monitoring_notes: Monitor for loss of efficacy if CYP3A4 inducers are initiated; assess orthostatic vital signs and CNS depression symptoms, particularly with CNS depressants. Maintain consistent B6 intake and separate iron supplementation by ≥2 hours from ropinirole dosing.
